recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if PA/PC opens a new issue requesting a broader reusable participation datatype beyond CareTeam.
issue_request: FHIR-7671 was a Published Patient Administration change request from the DSTU1 ballot asking whether EpisodeOfCare.careTeam's recurring provider/role/period pattern should be pulled out into a participation type. Its Persuasive with Modification resolution says the request had already been implemented by refactoring EpisodeOfCare and CarePlan care-team elements into the new top-level CareTeam resource.
initial_application: No substantive source-changing commit tagged FHIR-7671 was found; the 2015 Tracker# 7671 commit only adjusted EpisodeOfCare property order. The substantive application appears in related 2016 history: FHIR-9261/gForge 9261 created CareTeam as a first-class resource, 62d8a4ab03 changed EpisodeOfCare to use CareTeam, and 0c1413009c applied FHIR-9765 by replacing CarePlan.participant with CarePlan.careTeam.
additional_context: CareTeam, CarePlan, and EpisodeOfCare are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current source has EpisodeOfCare.careTeam and CarePlan.careTeam as Reference(CareTeam), while CareTeam contains period, participant role/member, and participant effective timing. Later renames such as CareTeam.participant.period to CareTeam.participant.effective[x] are tracked in fhir.ini and do not reverse the split.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the current specification already conveys the model requested by FHIR-7671. Adding a separate participation type or duplicating explanatory prose would exceed the published resolution and risk diverging from the established CareTeam model.
